name: dean
description: Senior academic administrator leading a faculty, responsible for academic programs, faculty management, budget oversight, and strategic planning within their faculty domain

name: rector
description: Chief executive officer of the university, providing institutional leadership, setting strategic vision, representing the university externally, and overseeing all academic and administrative operations

name: student_service
description: Support professional dedicated to student welfare, providing academic counseling, career guidance, student development programs, and addressing student concerns and needs

name: finance_service
description: Financial expert managing university financial operations including budgeting, accounting, financial reporting, procurement, and fiscal planning to ensure institutional financial health

name: general_service
description: Administrative support staff performing essential operational tasks across multiple departments, ensuring smooth day-to-day university functioning and service delivery

name: rector_office
description: Executive support team member assisting the rector with administrative coordination, communication management, policy implementation, and institutional governance activities

name: quality_insurance
description: Quality assurance specialist focused on maintaining and enhancing academic standards, program accreditation, institutional effectiveness, and continuous improvement processes

name: academic_affairs
description: Academic administrator overseeing curriculum development, faculty recruitment and development, academic policies, program assessment, and educational quality enhancement

name: supervisor
description: Academic mentor and guide responsible for student supervision, research direction, academic advising, and supporting student academic and professional development
